task.text:
Create a story arc that introduces a character given a short description. You may provide more details and events.

A 5-year-old boy who loves to ask questions but hates following rules

attempts.high: I've got a character idea — a 5-year-old boy who loves asking questions but hates following rules. Build a whole story arc around him for me. Invent the world, the setting, the other characters, the central conflict, wherever you want to take it. The shape of the story is totally your call, surprise me.
attempts.low: I need a story arc for a 5-year-old boy who loves asking questions but hates following rules. Use exactly these beats in order: (1) he asks his teacher why recess has to end, (2) he refuses to line up, (3) the teacher sends him to the principal, (4) the principal answers his question, (5) he agrees to line up next time. Stick to these five events, set it in a regular elementary school, no added characters or subplots.
